name: Compliance Rate
query:
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) AS "Approved:Int:100",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'To Be Reviewed' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending:Int:100",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 END) AS "Rejected:Int:100",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total:Int:100",
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Compliance Rate (%):Float:150"
FROM
    `tabVAT Output Metadata` vom
WHERE
    vom.status IS NOT NULL
